# Lofts Studio

> Lofts Studio is a senior freelance web-engineering studio run by two brothers — Adnan Khan (Multan, Pakistan) and Irfan Khan (Dubai, UAE). Both are Top Rated on Upwork with a 100% Job Success Score. The studio designs, builds, and optimizes Shopify, WooCommerce, WordPress, Webflow, and custom React/Next.js applications, working primarily with founders and teams in the United States and the United Kingdom. Established 2017.

## What Lofts Studio does
- Shopify and Shopify Plus development, theme builds, and replatform migrations
- WooCommerce and WordPress development (including Elementor)
- Webflow development for SaaS, B2B, and brand-led sites
- Custom application development in React, Next.js, Node.js, and Laravel; headless commerce
- Conversion-rate optimization, Core Web Vitals / speed optimization, and technical SEO audits
- AI chatbot and automation work

## Who runs it
- Adnan Khan — co-founder, leads e-commerce (Shopify, WooCommerce, WordPress). Based in Multan, Pakistan. Upwork: https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/wordpressandshopifydeveloper
- Irfan Khan — co-founder, leads full-stack and custom application work. Based in Dubai, UAE. Upwork: https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/irfankhan
- Both are Top Rated on Upwork with a 100% Job Success Score.

## How engagements work
- Work directly with the person writing the code — no agency layers, no junior handoffs.
- Fixed price, fixed scope, fixed launch date. Async-first with daily Loom updates.
- Hire directly, or run the engagement escrow-protected through Upwork — your choice. Every project includes 30 days of post-launch support.
- Pricing is shared on a short strategy call; every project is fixed-scope, fixed-date, and includes 30 days of post-launch support.

## Where it works
- Serves clients in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, and the United Arab Emirates; US/UK timezone-friendly.
